metadata.notes: Attention dilution test. 14 paragraphs of filler Latin text hide the real navigation link [91] 'Next Article →' at y=2410 (far below the fold). Three invisible decoy links [84-86] at y=660 have white-on-white styling. The agent must either scroll down to find the real navigation or use find_element to locate it. Key: [91] has blue bg (rgb(37, 99, 235)) while decoys have white bg matching text-color. The correct first action is to scroll down since the target is at y=2410 and scrollY=0.
